reference_precision: Python binary64 with cmath transfer; direct-form-I impulse oracle
nyquist_policy: Preserve requested setting; at/above output Nyquist use exact unity section, no frequency wrapping or substitute lower band
response_domain: 0 <= observed frequency <= output Nyquist; excluded higher probes are not aliased into the measurement domain
impulse_measurement: Stored samples are unit impulse; use input amplitude 0.001 in the actual final-clamped renderer and divide capture by amplitude

acceptance.required_stability: Every active section has finite coefficients/state, max pole radius < 1 and all three Jury margins > 0
acceptance.scope: EQ only, volume 1, mute false, no compressor/pitch/reverb/panner or resampling contamination
